name: Wild Terrain
storyline:
Wild Terrain is an animal adventure where you play as a wild boar searching for your missing piglets. Explore a vibrant natural world and experience the life of a wild animal in a wholesome, playful way.

Use your strength to smash, toss and forage through the environment. Charge through obstacles, knock over trash bins for food, and uncover secrets hidden across the land.

Help the forest recover by using mushrooms to heal toxic areas, and poop new flowers to rewild nature. Reunite with your piglets, travel together, and become a part of the living symbiosis between animals, plants and mushrooms.
summary: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.
